title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker
tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

faults.what: Large blurred filler bands were added above and below the original photo, introducing an unrequested decorative treatment despite the instruction not to change anything else.

judge.summary: The square image preserves the entire sneaker without distortion, but adds prominent blurred bands above and below the original photo.

must_haves.why: The output has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
must_haves.why: The sneaker's shape, stitching, laces, panels and sole match the source.

must_haves.item: The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
must_haves.why: The complete sneaker is visible with space around the toe, heel and sole.

must_haves.item: The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
must_haves.why: The sneaker retains the source image's proportions.

must_haves.item: The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.
must_haves.why: The original floor and background remain intact, but blurred decorative filler bands have been added at the top and bottom.
